options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished concept image of an idle racing game's revenue and rank indicator. Portrait 1024x1536, opaque full-bleed game scene, no outer border, no title, no explanation, no presentation board.
The supplied reference image is a composition and game-context reference ONLY. Replace its oversized money bubble and long white stalk with the specific new indicator described below. Do not reproduce the old stalk or giant bubble.
Style: Soft Miniature, 3D isometric viewed steeply from above, soft rounded toy diorama, pastel colors, matte clay and rubber, gentle ambient occlusion, soft daylight shadows. Game-ready readable UI over a charming miniature world, not photorealistic.
Scene: a sweeping curved grey racetrack with fine white dashed lane markings and subtle red-white curbs, mint pastel grass, a few round toy trees, a tiny roadside service station with cream walls and coral rounded roof. One identifiable small turquoise player racing car near the center-lower portion rounding the curve beside the station, two much less prominent pastel rival cars farther along the track. The road, grass, station and cars remain clearly visible. Scene fills every edge; no sky or blank background. Keep a comparable composition and scale across concepts.
UI: crisp bold rounded sans-serif, compact dark teal labels, clean white lettering and restrained green money accent. UI is screen-facing and legible. Indicators should be modest in size, close to their target, avoid occluding scenery. No long connector lines, no large circular money bubble, no extra menus, no watermark.

OPTION 1 — COMBINED PILL. A single compact horizontal dark teal pill immediately above the player car, width about twice the car length and height less than half car length. Left: tiny green banknote icon. Middle: exact white text "P3/8". Right: exact light mint text "+$120", within this SAME pill, with enough padding. One tiny downward triangular tail almost touching the car roof. No other floating labels, no station income marker, no fixed HUD. Only text in the image is "P3/8" and "+$120".
